name: Green Cove Springs
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Green Cove Springs, FL 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Green Cove Springs, FL: Christmas on Walnut Street, the parade, Parade of Trees and Christmas in the Village.
lede: Green Cove Springs goes all in for Christmas with a downtown festival and parade, a park full of lit trees and an evening Christmas village at the fairgrounds.
celebrates: The City of Green Cove Springs builds its Christmas around Spring Park and Walnut Street. Christmas on Walnut Street fills a Saturday with vendors, a free Jingle Bell Fun Run, Santa at his workshop in the pool pavilion, live music, a night parade down Highway 17 and the lighting of the city tree. Parade of Trees lights 245 decorated trees in Spring Park every evening in December. At the Clay County Fairgrounds, Christmas in the Village opens the Early Florida Village after dark on five nights, and the county library hosts Belle's ornament party.
lastyear: The City of Green Cove Springs' Parade of Trees page still carries older wording that describes the park glowing with more than 160 lit trees, while Explore Clay counts 245 for 2026. The city's Letters to Santa page also keeps older dates from 2022, when families placed letters in Santa's mailbox by the Spring Park pool pavilion or mailed them to City Hall. The Clay County Fair says its Early Florida Village is otherwise open at fair time until 7 pm.
facts: Christmas on Walnut Street includes a one mile Jingle Bell Fun Run organized by the Florida Striders, and Santa's workshop is organized by the Green Cove Springs Elks Lodge Number 1892. The Christmas Parade is organized by the Green Cove Springs Business League and runs down Highway 17. Spring Park is at 200 Spring Street, and the Clay County Fairgrounds' Early Florida Village is at 2493 State Road 16 W.
trains: Green Cove Springs' 2026 listings do not include a train ride. The nearest railroad museum entry on our site is the Jacksonville terminal page, and our Jacksonville guide has more train and light events. For something with an old time feel, Christmas in the Village uses the Early Florida Village buildings at the fairgrounds, lit up after dark on five December evenings.
train_links: The closest train museum page on our site, in Jacksonville.
traditions: Vendors, Santa's workshop, live music, a parade and the city tree lighting in one day.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Green Cove Springs for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Sniktaw Farms 1st Annual Christmas Market) through December 31, with Parade of Trees in Spring Park (December 1), Christmas in the Village at Early Florida Village (December 4) and Christmas on Walnut Street and Parade (December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Green Cove Springs

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Green Cove Springs
  • 2 free events: Christmas on Walnut Street and Parade and Parade of Trees in Spring Park
  • Meet Santa: Santa photos at Sniktaw Farms Christmas Market, Santa's workshop at Christmas on Walnut Street, and Santa at Christmas in the Village
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Christmas Parade and city tree lighting on December 5, and 245 lit trees at Parade of Trees
  • Lights: a walk through Christmas lights at dusk at Sniktaw Farms on November 28
  • Trains: none listed
  • Season: November 28, 2026 to December 31, 2026
